title: Calculator haircut schedule
text: Haircut schedule used by the calculator. Its cash, AA- or better, main index equity and gold rows match BCBS-IOSCO d499 Appendix B. Its A+ to BBB- rows and other equity are not in d499. Cash haircut is 0 percent. Government bonds rated AA- or better are 0.5 percent under one year, 2 percent for one to five years, and 4 percent over five years. Corporate bonds rated AA- or better are 1 percent under one year, 4 percent for one to five years, and 8 percent over five years. Corporate bonds rated A+ to BBB- are 2 percent under one year, 6 percent for one to five years, and 12 percent over five years. Main index equity is 15 percent. Other equity is 25 percent. Gold is 15 percent.

source: BCBS-IOSCO, Margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives (d499, April 2020), Appendix B, page 26. Brief excerpt; (c) Bank for International Settlements 2020
title: d499 Appendix B cash and government securities
text: Appendix B. Standardised haircut schedule. Cash in same currency 0. High-quality government and central bank securities: residual maturity less than one year 0.5. High-quality government and central bank securities: residual maturity between one and five years 2. High-quality government and central bank securities: residual maturity greater than five years 4.
